name: Black blended rum (Jamaica)
description: Dark blended rum from Jamaica: as dark as the Demerara side of the category, but with Jamaica's funky, fruity pot-still signature instead of smoky weight. Coruba and Hamilton's Jamaican Pot Still Black are the benchmarks — a Coruba Mai Tai is practically a style of its own — and a float of it deepens Jet Pilot-style drinks.
